product.name: Monoprice Specialty Ceiling Mounted TV Wall Mount Bracket Quad Sided For 32 To 65 TVs up to 66 lbs. each Max VESA 600x400
product.description: Put information or entertainment where people can see it, regardless of wall space with this Quad Sided Ceiling TV Mount Bracket from Monoprice™. Make your content viewable from any point in your facility with this 360° digital signage ceiling bracket. Installation is as simple as with a single screen TV mount you put on your wall, though we do recommend only qualified personnel mount large displays in public areas. All hardware is included to mount most flat panel displays from any pitch ceiling. Hang 32" ~ 65" TVs* with weights up to 66 lbs. each safely and securely with plenty of space for cable management to keep it looking neat too. Screens can be adjusted from ±15° and hang 2.62 ~ 10.68 feet from the ceiling. Professional grade quality, variable hardware options included, all at a price that makes sense.Features: Easily mount 4 large TVs for convenient viewing of information or broadcasts from anywhere in the roomNo special hardware or tools required to install multiple displaysSingle column drop hangs screens 2.62 ~ 10.68 feet from ceilingAccommodates any 32" ~ 65" TV* weighing up to 66 lbs. each, with 100x100 ~ 600x400 VESA® mounting patterns*The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations. Your TV will work with this mount as long as it has a compatible VESA® pattern and maximum weight.
